    "My thermometer and caster purchases seem to have been stretched into needs for temperature automation and heavy lifting, even though those are different tasks."

  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [

    "Voltage, equipment requirements, and the exact task matter to me more than a shared word such as relay or temperature.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so an older project purchase alone gives little reason to assume I need a specialized accessory now."
